what: Every exterior finding of the joint audit (geometryClosureAudit) on the ten recorded descriptions, rebuilt with no reader call: a verdict per class, the cause, what was changed in the builder, and what stands. Severities were not changed; the audit was not changed.
scoredControlKept: S53-E3-RESULT.json keeps the control as scored (builder 0.1.0: 3-7 findings per house, one compile error). Everything here is DEV work after it.

classes.cause: the builder set every terrace's top 2 cm below its storey's floor level, so the terrace stood 2 cm under the foot of the wall it lies against
classes.fix: terrace top at the level's elevation, as the drawings' path sets it

classes.what: canopy plate INTERSECTION with a roof plane (0.01-0.56 m3)
classes.cause: the clearance under a roof was tested at the plate's centre only; the eaves that reach over the plate's inner part cut through it
classes.fix: where the plate as stated would stand in a roof, it begins at the roof's edge and is no higher than that edge; named in the result

classes.what: canopy plate COPLANAR_DUPLICATE / INTERSECTION with a body's walls, slab or with its own posts (plate stated partly or wholly within a body)
classes.verdict: REAL_CONSTRUCTION_DEFECT, and behind three of them a DESCRIBED_BUT_LOST form
classes.cause: a canopy stated inside a body's rectangle was built as a plate through the walls. The reader states a recessed porch that way (the body's rectangle takes in the porch); one shallow case is a canopy the reader kept inside the frame (its own note says so)
classes.fix: cut back to open ground; under a metre deep against one face: built projecting from that face; across a whole face and deeper: the walls stand back under the body's own roof, which keeps its outline, on posts (extradom-pl-1: compared with its side elevations, which draw the roof running on over an open end on a post); part of a face or a corner: said and not built
classes.left: a porch cut out of a corner or of part of a face (dobredomy-pl-1) is not built - the model has the form (PocketV2), the described builder does not use it yet

classes.what: canopy <-> canopy COPLANAR_DUPLICATE and INTERSECTION (an L-shaped porch stated as two rectangles that overlap)
classes.cause: each canopy was built without regard to the others
classes.fix: a canopy is cut back from one already built at its height

classes.what: balcony slab INTERSECTION with the main roof plane (0.10 and 0.16 m3)
classes.cause: a balcony in front of a dormer stands where the roof's eaves run on: the model has no way to interrupt an eave, so the slab passes through it

classes.what: balcony <-> entrance canopy INTERSECTION, COPLANAR_DUPLICATE and a post GAP
classes.cause: a canopy stated under a balcony at the balcony's own height: two covers in one place
classes.fix: a canopy is cut back from under a balcony at its height (the balcony is the cover there)

classes.what: flat roof plate COPLANAR_DUPLICATE with the tops of its own walls (0.86-1.19 m2 a wall)
classes.cause: the plate's top was set at the walls' top, so the strip of plate bearing on each wall and the wall's top were drawn in one plane
classes.fix: the stated eaves height is the walls' top; the plate lies 0.15 m below it within the walls

classes.what: canopy post INTERSECTION with a wall (0.10 m3)
classes.cause: posts were set along an edge that runs along another body's wall
classes.fix: a post is never placed within a body; a body carries the canopy there

classes.what: canopy <-> wall GAP of 0.01-0.09 m under PARAPET<->FLAT_ROOF BEARING
classes.verdict: three REAL (an edge stated a few centimetres from a face it belongs on), three AUDIT_RELATION_ARTEFACT with no visible defect
classes.cause: real: canopies were not snapped to the bodies' faces as the bodies are to one another. Artefact: a canopy is emitted as a flat roof, so the audit expects it to bear into every wall beside it - also the wall ring of the storey above a plate whose top is 2 cm under that storey's floor (domoweklimaty-pl-2: plate 2.60-2.78 m against the ground-storey wall, which runs to 2.80 m behind it), and a wall whose top under a single slope is 9 cm below a plate that lies against the roof's edge (houseplans-com-1: wall top 2.71 m, roof edge 2.71-3.00 m, plate 2.80-2.98 m)
classes.fix: edges within 0.25 m of a face are put on it. The three artefacts stand as ERRORs: a canopy would need a type of its own for the audit to know what it meets

describedVersusBuilt.note: over the ten descriptions, with builder 0.5.0: what the reader stated against what the model holds. Whatever is missing here was lost in the build and can be worked on with no new reading; what the reader never stated (dormers on one house, second chimneys, rooflights) is not in these counts and needs a reading.
lostInBuild: 3 of 124 openings (a wall 7 cm high under a roof; one blocked by a body; one stated on a side that is open under the porch)
4 of 13 rooflights (two on a hip's end plane, two on an attached cross gable: the described builder places rooflights only on a body's two main slopes)
2 of 15 canopies (one covered by the eaves; one a corner recess)

sideEffects: the two houses with a long porch keep every stated post (7; 6+3+2)
extradom-pl-1: one window stated on a side that is now open under the porch is dropped by name
lipinscy-pl-2: its 0.6 m entrance canopy is now covered by the eaves and not built as a plate (it was a plate through the wall before)
flat-roofed bodies show a 0.15 m upstand; their terraces' guards stand on the plate
